from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Captures the title and classification of a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The exact title of the judgment document as written in the text")
    case_types: list[Literal['刑事案件', '执行案件', '赔偿案件', '行政案件', '民事案件', '管辖案件']] = Field(
        description="The classification(s) applicable to this document from the 6 categories specified in the task"
    )

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed document instances."""
    documents: list[Document]
